entities.summary: Edgar Moreira da Cunha, S.D.V. is a Brazilian-born American Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Fall River in Massachusetts since 2014. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Newark in New Jersey and is a member of the Vocationists. Edgar Moreira da Cunha was a religious figures from Riachão do Jacuípe (b. 1957-08-21, Riachão do Jacuípe). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
